Do you want to help turn operational data into reliable insights that support the safe and efficient operation of our wind assets? We’re looking for an OT O&M Manager for Information & Data to lead the services that make critical operational information available, reliable and ready to support better decisions across Business Area Wind.

Reliable operational information and data are essential for running and managing Business Area Wind’s assets. They enable operational decision-making, performance monitoring, reporting, engineering and the exchange of information with internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for an OT O&M (Operation and Maintenance) Manager for Information & Data within the OT team in Business Area Wind. This is an operational management role with end-to-end accountability for the performance, availability, reliability and continuous improvement of this business-critical service area.

You do not need to be the technical expert in every information and data domain. You do, however, need a strong understanding of OT environments and data-driven services and the ability to lead technical teams, challenge and support specialists, set priorities, make decisions and ensure that issues are driven through to resolution.

For this role, leadership, Accountability and Proactivity are as important as technical understanding. You will create the structure and momentum needed to deliver reliable information and data services.

The OT Information & Data service area is responsible for making operational data and digital asset information available, reliable and usable across Business Area Wind. The service area connects local assets, fleet operations and enterprise consumers while supporting controlled information exchange with external authorities and joint-venture partners.

The scope includes operational data provisioning and integration, data quality management, enterprise engineering services, operational reporting, advanced data-driven solutions and lifecycle management of OT information and data.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

You will take end-to-end ownership of the OT Information & Data service area and ensure that operational data and digital asset information remain available, reliable and usable for teams across Business Area Wind. You will set clear priorities for the service area, lead and develop service managers, engineers and domain experts, and create the governance needed to manage performance, risks, costs and dependencies. A key part of the role is to shape the service strategy and roadmap, balancing stable day-to-day delivery with lifecycle needs and the operationalisation of new data-driven solutions. Working across OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects and suppliers, you will bring the right expertise together, resolve issues and ensure improvements are followed through to completion.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

• Take end-to-end accountability for the OT Information & Data service area, including its performance, availability, reliability, cost and continuous improvement.

• Lead and develop the service area team, setting clear priorities and expectations while empowering service managers, engineers and domain experts to deliver within their areas of expertise.

• Drive operational performance, ensuring service risks, data-quality issues, dependencies and improvement needs are proactively identified, prioritised and followed through to resolution.

• Own the service strategy and roadmap, including priorities, budget, resources, lifecycle needs and the development of information and data services in line with Business Area Wind’s operational requirements.

• Manage the OT Information & Data service portfolio, ensuring reliable standard services while enabling new and advanced data-driven solutions to be operationalised and scaled.

• Provide effective operational governance, using service performance, risks, KPIs and expert input to make decisions, manage priorities and ensure clear accountability.

• Manage stakeholders and interfaces across Business Area Wind, bringing together data and analytics, OT, Operations, IT, Cybersecurity, Engineering, projects, suppliers and business stakeholders to resolve issues and deliver results.

• Drive continuous improvement in services, processes, data quality and ways of working, ensuring OT Information & Data remains reliable and fit for future business needs.

Your profile / who are you?

You combine a solid understanding of OT information and data environments with leadership experience from complex operational settings. You are comfortable taking Accountability for a broad service area without needing to be the technical expert in every domain. Instead, you create clarity, set priorities and empower specialists to deliver within their areas of expertise. With Proactivity, Collaboration, Composure and a Solution-Oriented approach, you use performance information, risks and expert input to make informed decisions and keep topics moving. You build strong relationships across technical teams, business functions and suppliers, and you are motivated by improving service reliability, data quality and ways of working over time.

Next to this you bring:

• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in operational management, O&M, IT/OT service management, information and data management, engineering management or asset management, preferably within energy or another asset-intensive industry.

• Experience leading technical teams or services in a complex operational environment, with a track record of improving performance and driving issues through to resolution.

• A good understanding of OT information and data environments, sufficient to lead specialists, understand risks and dependencies, challenge recommendations and make informed decisions.

• Strong service-management capabilities, including operational performance, governance, risk management, lifecycle planning and continuous improvement.

• Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical teams, business functions, suppliers and management.

• A relevant degree in engineering, technology, information or data management, business or a similar discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands - Kolding, Denmark

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position, you are welcome to contact hiring manager Hasan Özdem, hasan.oezdem@vattenfall.de. For more information about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 03.12.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfil within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, Validata.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Where there’s you, there’s a way.

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Design our AI landscape - and help build it

DOVISTA is building a new digital capability. Digital Innovation & AI brings enterprise architecture, digital innovation and AI together in one department with a clear purpose: set the direction for our future IT landscape, build the shared data, AI and integration platforms our solutions stand on, and build the digital products that make it easier for dealers, partners and colleagues to work with our brands.

We are looking for a highly experienced AI Architect who will define how DOVISTA builds, connects, runs and governs AI, and who simply cannot stay away from the delivery. You will set the technical direction, develop the engineers around you and lift our AI capability across the organisation. You will shape our future AI landscape and solutions across all DOVISTA, and you will be in the code, the pipelines and the design sessions making it real.

You will work side by side with our Product Leader and our enterprise architects, so that what we build, why we build it and how it fits the target architecture always move in the same direction. You will also help IT itself harvest the benefits of AI, from a faster, multilingual service desk to software engineering that is quicker than ever and reviewed by AI.

About the department

Digital Innovation & AI is part of the group function Digital Solutions and has three areas:

• Enterprise Architecture - owns the IT target architecture, architecture principles and the architecture board

• Digital Innovation - builds new digital products for customers, partners and colleagues

• AI - builds and enables AI solutions and the shared AI capabilities other products reuse across DOVISTA

Define the AI target landscape

• Define the future AI architecture and solution landscape as part of DOVISTA's target architecture, together with our enterprise architects

• Set AI architecture principles, reference architectures and reusable patterns

• Bring AI decisions to the architecture board and make sure solutions move us towards the target

Design the AI platform and connectivity

• Shape the AI platform we build on: model access, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, deployment and operations

• Define how MCP and APIs expose business capabilities such as rules, pricing, validation and product data to agents and applications

• Keep business logic in shared services, agents and the data platform, with thin applications on top

Architect and build our new digital products, hands-on

• Contribute directly to delivery: prototypes, code, prompts, pipelines, evaluations and reviews

Make us faster with AI-native delivery

• Define how we build customer-facing solutions in the experience layer with agentic coding and AI

• Set up the practices that keep quality high at speed: automated testing, evaluation, code review, CI/CD and security by design

• Coach engineers and partners in working effectively and responsibly with AI coding tools

Choose the right tool

• Guide the organisation on when to use AI, and when rules engines, integration, automation or conventional software are the better choice

• Balance model choice, quality, latency and cost for each use case

• Challenge ideas and designs with data, prototypes and honest trade-offs

Govern, monitor and control cost

• Define how AI usage, agents and tool access are monitored, logged and governed across the organisation, e.g. through an AI and MCP gateway

• Put token budgets, cost attribution and model routing in place, so we know what AI costs and what it returns

• Build in security, privacy, guardrails and compliance with regulation such as the EU AI Act from the start

Harvest the benefits of AI in IT

• Accelerate our service desk and support with AI, so colleagues get fast, high-quality help in all our languages

• Enable software engineers across IT to write code faster than ever, at high quality and with AI-assisted code review built into the workflow

• Measure the effect, e.g. resolution time, first-contact resolution, lead time and change failure rate, and scale what works

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience, including several years as a senior, lead or principal architect for AI or data solutions

• You have designed, built and run generative AI and agentic solutions in production, not only in pilots

• Deep knowledge of LLMs, agent orchestration, retrieval, evaluation and LLMOps, and of protocols such as MCP

• Experience designing AI or data platforms in the cloud, integrated with ERP, CRM and other enterprise systems

• Experience with AI-assisted and agentic software development, including AI code review, and with building customer-facing digital solutions

• Experience with AI governance, security, observability and cost management at enterprise scale

• Experience with AI in IT service management and support, ERP environments or manufacturing is an advantage

• Proven experience building AI solutions that delivered measurable business value and ran at scale, not only pilots

• Deep hands-on experience with agentic coding and how to apply it across the entire development process

Skills

• You still write code and enjoy it. APIs, infrastructure as code and CI/CD are familiar ground

• AI is not your only hammer. You know when a problem needs AI, and when it needs rules, integration, data work or conventional software

• You turn complex architecture into clear choices and trade-offs for executives, product leaders and engineers

• You think in cost, quality and risk, not only in capability

• You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and are fluent in English

As a person

• A builder at heart who cannot stay away from the delivery

• Pragmatic: you prefer working software over long documents

• Opinionated, curious and quick to learn, and open to being proven wrong

• Generous with knowledge and happy to lift the people around you

What we offer

• The chance to define DOVISTA's AI landscape from the start, and to build it yourself

• A real, commercially important solution to architect from day one

• A department where architecture, product and AI sit together

• An international group of brands with the long-term perspective of a foundation-owned company

Practical information

• Location: Denmark and Poland.

• Working model: We support flexible ways of working, recognising that the right balance depends on the role, the team and business needs.

• Travel: Some travel across Europe should be expected.

Want to know more?

If this sounds like the kind of role you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We will be inviting for interviews shortly and will close the position once we have found the right match.

If you have any questions about the role, please contact the hiring manager Anders Butzbach Christensen, Senior Director, Digital Innovation & AI, at abut@dovista.com.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people’s everyday lives.

Each brand has its own story, expertise, and strengths, yet all work to improve everyday living through quality solutions that meet our customers’ needs and shape homes and buildings that connect people with the world outside.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.

Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

We have invested in applied AI since 2020, well ahead of the market, and that early conviction has paid off. Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.

The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.

If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.

Our Mission

We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.

**The Role

**Juristic is a Danish legal tech company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Copenhagen. Our platform brings four tools together on the same case data: Structure, Timeline, Flow and JuristIQ, our legal AI in chat and tabular formats.

Clients include PwC, Bird & Bird and Bech-Bruun. Juristic is now part of Board Intelligence, and we are bringing a new product to market. The work is led by our CTO, and we are looking for an AI Engineer to build it with them from the first line of code.

This is a zero-to-one role in a small team of four full-stack developers, a machine learning engineer and the CTO. You will write the code, sit in front of customers, and help decide what we build next.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and ship the AI capabilities at the core of a new product, from first prototype to production

• Own LLM-powered workflows end to end, such as document understanding, data extraction and agentic assistants

• Choose and integrate models and providers, and own the prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails that make AI output reliable enough for legal and governance work

• Work directly with customers and the CTO to turn real problems into product decisions, and help own the product roadmap

• Lay the engineering foundations for the new product, including architecture, testing, observability and deployment, so it can scale

• Work with the wider Juristic and Board Intelligence engineering teams, and contribute to AI tooling shared across the suite

**Person Specification

**We are looking for a builder: an experienced AI engineer who has been a technical founder or an early employee at a startup, and who is ready to do it again.

Required Skills and Experience:

• At least four years of professional software engineering experience

• Experience as a technical founder or early employee at a startup, having built a product from the first line of code

• A track record of building and shipping AI or LLM-powered products to real users

• Practical experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval and evaluating model output in production

• Strong engineering fundamentals across backend and frontend, with the judgement to move fast without leaving a mess behind

• A strong product mindset: you have worked directly with customers and owned a product roadmap

• Hungry, motivated and ready for another zero-to-one journey

• Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

Experience with our stack: TypeScript (Node.js and React) and Python

Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing and extraction from unstructured text

Experience building agentic systems, tool use or MCP integrations

Experience with search and retrieval infrastructure, such as Elasticsearch or vector databases

A background in legal tech, governance or B2B SaaS for professional users

What good looks like in this role:

• After three months: you know our customers, the product vision and the codebase, and you have shipped AI features that real users rely on

• After six months: the core AI capabilities of the new product are in production, backed by evaluations that show they are reliable, and you are acting on customer feedback

• After twelve months: the product is in market with paying customers, you are a trusted voice on the roadmap, and the AI foundations you built are reused across the Juristic and Board Intelligence suite

**How We Work

**We hire people who are expert at what they do. Once you join, you have the autonomy to shape how you work and the space to do it well. That doesn’t mean working in isolation. You’ll have colleagues who know their craft, regular collaboration across functions, and easy access to senior leadership when you need it.

We keep our structure flat. We work at pace in an agile, nimble environment where good ideas don’t wait for permission. If you spot something that could work better, we encourage you to say so. If you want to run with an idea, we’ll back you to do it.

We work with people who take pride in their output, back their team through the hard parts, and leave things better than they found them.

**What Happens Next

**Once you apply, our Talent team will review your application. If there’s a fit, they’ll be in touch to discuss the role and next steps.

**How We Use AI In Our Hiring

**We use AI responsibly, both in the software we build for governance teams and in how we hire. Our Talent team may use AI to support application review, CV analysis, or identifying areas that need further verification.

But hiring decisions are made by people. AI surfaces signals; people make the call on whether to progress a candidate or extend an offer.

If you’d like details on how your data is handled during recruitment, contact our Talent team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

**We’re an equal opportunities employer. We’re building a team that works because it reflects a breadth of experience, background, and perspective.

Apply even if you don’t tick every box on the job specification. If the role excites you and you think you could make an impact, we want to hear from you.

We don’t discriminate on the basis of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of recruitment, or if there’s anything else we can do to make the process more accessible, tell our Talent team. We’ll sort it.

**Your Safety Matters

**Be cautious of unexpected messages claiming to be from Board Intelligence. We will never ask you for fees as part of recruitment. If you’re unsure whether a communication is genuine, contact our Talent team through our official channels before sharing information or clicking links.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you combine a strong creative vision with exceptional sketching skills and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials and the jewellery design process?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Designer to join our Modern Classics & Diamonds team on a 12-month fixed-term contract, bringing creative expertise and immediate impact to one of Pandora's key jewellery categories.

**Create the next generation of Modern Classics & Diamonds

**As our Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director and wider design team to develop creative projects from initial concept through design execution and prototype development.

Drawing on your creative vision, technical expertise and understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will help develop compelling, commercially relevant collections that combine timeless elegance with modern expression and inspire customers around the world.

**Your Role

****Design & Collection Development

**

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs and sketches aligned with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas supporting the strategic direction of the category.

• Develop mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches and technical drawings to support product development.

• Review CADs and provide clear and comprehensive creative feedback within agreed timelines.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and contribute to formal prototype reviews and creative evaluations.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, inspiration references and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing creative and technical guidance.

• Ensure projects are developed and delivered according to agreed timelines and requirements.

**Research & Innovation

**

• Conduct research based on briefs from Creative Leadership and translate insights into strong creative concepts.

• Participate in research activities and trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials and creative inspiration.

• Contribute ideas for new concepts, innovation opportunities and future category directions.

• Keep design presentations updated with relevant concepts, sketches and final designs throughout project development.

**A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery

**You combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an instinct for commercially relevant product design. You know how to take an idea from inspiration and early sketches through to a beautifully resolved piece of jewellery.

You understand how to balance innovation with the DNA of an established global brand and are comfortable moving between creative exploration and the technical realities of product development.

As this is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity, we are particularly looking for someone who can quickly become part of the team, confidently take ownership of projects and contribute from day one.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Significant experience designing jewellery within a jewellery, luxury, fashion or accessories brand.

• A strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches and finished products.

• Proven experience taking design projects from concept through CAD and prototype development.

• Strong knowledge of jewellery design, craftsmanship, materials and manufacturing processes.

• Exceptional hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into distinctive and commercially relevant products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills within an international environment.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools, including Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign.

**Important

**Please include a portfolio as part of your application, showcasing your design work, creative process, sketching and technical capabilities, and examples of collections or products you have helped take from concept to final execution.

Applications without a portfolio may not be considered.

**Your New Team

**As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery.

You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing and Product Development.

**Additional Information

**This is a 12-month fixed-term contract based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**If you see yourself in this opportunity and would like to contribute to Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Head of Group FP&A

At Salling Group, we are on an ambitious growth journey. As we continue to grow across markets, formats and businesses, the ability to connect performance, investments and strategic priorities becomes increasingly important.

We are looking for a Head of Group FP&A to lead and further develop our Group-wide financial planning and performance management agenda. This is one of the most impactful leadership roles in Finance, offering a unique opportunity to shape how financial insights support decisions, prioritization and long-term value creation across the Group.

The role

As Head of Group FP&A, you will lead a strong team and play a key role in strengthening how we understand, plan and improve business performance across Salling Group. You will help create a more connected view of performance, ensuring that financial and operational insights are translated into actions that make a difference.

Reporting directly to the CFO, you will be part of the Finance Leadership Team and our Global Finance Board. In close collaboration with business leaders and finance teams across our organization, you will help shape decisions related to performance, investments, growth opportunities and resource allocation.

This role is about much more than reporting and budgeting. It is about challenging assumptions, identifying opportunities, developing future finance talent and helping the business navigate an increasingly dynamic environment.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. **About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.
